name: Takamiya Shizuru
source:
A symbol of the school whom everyone respects.
Resolute and composed. She practices kyudo.
The chairman’s daughter.
However, she doesn’t get along with her father, the chairman.
She’s quite beautiful, but because she gives off a cool, unapproachable vibe at first glance,
Hardly any boys try to hit on her.
She doesn’t socialize much.
And she doesn’t like to talk about herself.
Aoi’s friend (though it’s really just Aoi who
unilaterally considers her a friend).
While retaining her nobility, her body descends into the depths of pleasure.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120113233718if_/http://www.luchs.jp/psychs/reigaku/chara02.html]official site, archived[/url]]
